script: A digital career works best when it fits your life. Your family, your health and your rest matter more than any single job. This chapter helps you protect your time, and grow your income step by step. Start by protecting your time. Set fixed working hours, and tell your family and your clients what they are. Use a timer for short, focused blocks, such as forty-five minutes of work followed by a ten-minute break. Keep one place for work. When the laptop or the work notebook is closed, the job is done for the day. And say no to work that does not fit your hours, even if it pays well. Good clients respect clear limits.
